Written `RESULTS.json` (untracked, no commits made).

| June growth | +4.6% |
| July growth | −9.6% |

**The one judgment call:** June's report states total costs of €158,240, but its own cost table sums to €158,540 — a €300 gap. May and July both reconcile to the cent, so I treated June's bold total as a typo and used the line-item sum. That's the number in `q_costs_eur`. Using June's stated total instead would give costs €467,640 and net €765,585; margin rounds to 62.1% either way. Both figures are recorded in `notes` so the choice is visible and reversible.

Also flagged in `notes`: July revenue fell 9.6% month-on-month, and churn climbed every month (17 → 22 → 31), pulling monthly net adds down from 69 in May to 32 in July. The headline quarterly figures look healthy, but the within-quarter trend is downward on both revenue and customers.
